name: Misawa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Misawa city emblem in yellow: a ring of three arcs with radiating strokes enclosing a stylised character, within a thin yellow border.
history: Municipal flag of Misawa, a city in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 September 1988; the emblem dates from 25 November 1958.

features.role: Misawa city emblem — a ring of three arcs with radiating strokes enclosing a stylised character
